evidence.reason: At the current tip, subprocess.Popen is followed by recorder.append outside the protected try block. If the append raises, boot skips its except cleanup and process.json is never written, so the boot-local path does not terminate the QEMU process it just spawned. The fix is to put the append inside the try or otherwise arm cleanup immediately after Popen.
